projects.title: Hey Buddy
projects.subtitle: A little companion. A calmer workday.
projects.summary: A digital AI companion for Windows that keeps tasks moving, brings timely reminders, and turns your progress into clear daily and weekly updates.
projects.details:
Work moves quickly. Tasks arrive in conversations, reminders get scattered, and reporting becomes another task at the end of the day. Hey Buddy brings those pieces together in a friendly desktop companion.

Tell Buddy what needs doing, paste your weekly plan, or say “Hey Buddy.” Keep progress and blockers alongside your tasks, get nudges from a small on-screen character, and prepare reports from what you actually logged.

Built with Electron for Windows, the project combines a practical task workspace with a companion you can personalise: a robot, a man, a woman, or your own image. Drag it to a screen corner, set your work hours, and use focus mode when you need room to concentrate.

features.title: Capture work naturally
features.text: Type, paste a weekly plan, or use voice to add tasks, reminders, progress updates, and blockers.

features.title: Remember the right things
features.text: One-off and repeating reminders, task priorities, pause/resume controls, and quick answers to “What’s due today?”

features.title: Stay focused, stay human
features.text: An on-screen companion brings check-ins, water and stretch breaks, and an end-of-day wrap-up. Focus mode pauses check-ins and breaks while reminders continue.

features.title: Turn progress into a report
features.text: Prepare a daily stand-up or weekly summary from your logged work, edit it, and copy it into your usual communication tools.

features.title: Choose your AI connection
features.text: Connect supported ChatGPT, Claude, or Google accounts through their command-line tools, or use an OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini API key. Add backups for automatic fallback.

features.title: Keep local control
features.text: Tasks and settings are stored on your PC with a rolling backup. Speech recognition runs offline; AI requests send messages and a task/reminder summary to your chosen provider.

setup: Download the Windows installer or choose the portable ZIP.
Open Settings and add your preferred AI connection. Account sign-in needs Node.js LTS; API-key connections do not.
Add your name, save your settings, and tell Buddy about your first task.
projects.installNote: The installer is not commercially signed, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning. See the release notes and setup guide before installing.
